- We should avoid pairing two senior infra interviewers in the same slot (balance with product/infra).

Attached: candidate resume + interview matrix.

Can you reply with which slot(s) you can cover? Proposed schedule (PT):
- Slot A: 10:15–11:00 — system design (45m)
- Slot B: 11:15–12:00 — backend/algorithms (45m)
- Slot C: 12:15–13:00 — product sense / trade-offs (45m)
- Debrief: 15:00–15:30 — debrief / score consolidation

If you can't make any of these, please suggest an immediate swap and I’ll ping the standby list. Need final confirmation by EOD today so recruiter can lock the candidate calendar.

Thanks —
